Select compound ChEMBL identifier and canonical SMILES for compounds tested against the human CB2 receptor in human assays. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then to assays, then to target_dictionary, filtering for target name 'Cannabinoid CB2 receptor' and organism 'Homo sapiens' on both target and assay. Join compound_structures to retrieve canonical SMILES. Return distinct rows ordered by compound ChEMBL identifier.
